_about: Prepared answers of the offline mock model (reconix-mock-1). Shared by the TUI (reconix/llm/mock.py) and the web (apps/web/src/lib/assistant/models/mock-replies.json, written by apps/web/scripts/sync-mock-replies.mjs; a test in each app checks the copies match). Intents are tried in order; the first pattern that matches (case-insensitive) wins. Patterns use only syntax Python and JavaScript read the same way. {name} is filled from the assessment's facts; 'needs' names the fact the reply uses, and 'empty' is the reply when that fact is missing.

intents.reply: Secrets are masked: I never see them and can't show them. Evidence and logs keep them as ••••.
I can't do that. Only you can approve, reject, run or change anything, with the menu Reconix shows. {step}

I'm the Reconix mock model (reconix-mock-1). I run offline on this computer for testing, and my answers are prepared examples, not a real AI. I can explain the scope, the plan, the findings and the report. I can't approve, run a tool or change the scope: only you can, with the app's menu.

I explain this assessment from its own data: what is in scope, what happens next, the plan, the findings and how to fix them, and the report. Try: what is in scope?, what happens next?, summarize the findings, explain finding 001, what is the most serious finding? I can't approve, run or change anything.

intents.missing: There is no finding {id} in this assessment. Its findings are: {ids}.

intents.reply: The most serious finding is {top}. Ask 'explain finding {top_id}' for its impact and fix.
{count}: {list}. Ask 'explain finding 001' for one of them.

intents.empty: There is no scope yet. Type a target to start, and Reconix drafts a scope for you to approve.
There is no plan yet. It comes after you approve the scope.

intents.reply: The report collects the approved scope, the findings with their masked evidence and how to fix them. Export it once the run is complete: in the terminal on the Report screen (p PDF, j JSON, w DOCX), in the web from Reports.
Hi! I'm the Reconix mock model. Ask me about the scope, the plan or the findings.
Bye! Press Ctrl+Q to quit Reconix.

fallback: I'm a mock model, so I only answer prepared questions. Try: who are you?, what is in scope?, what happens next?, summarize the findings, explain finding 001.
